temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough, that she keeps wondering if more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knew Shirley was a caring colleague involved with the patient, but she did not yet know the depth of Shirley's grief or self-doubt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed, and she learns Shirley is grieving and struggling with possible guilt over the patient's death.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply grieving the patient's death, feels the loss strongly, and is having difficulty letting go; she may be questioning whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort and reassure Shirley, remind her they did all they could, and support her through the grief.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara hears Shirley explicitly say she feels responsible for the outcome and wonders whether pushing for a different treatment approach might have helped; Shirley appreciates Sara's reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was deeply grieving and suspected she might feel burdened by the patient's death, but she had not yet confirmed the extent of Shirley's self-blame about treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara's suspicion is confirmed and sharpened: Shirley carries an explicit sense of responsibility and second-guesses the treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible and burdened by guilt over the treatment outcome; reassurance helps somewhat, but she still struggles to accept it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathetic, concerned, supportive, and worried about Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility by emphasizing that they made the best decisions with the information available, and to share the burden with her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive, then hears Shirley admit she holds back because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak; Shirley agrees to try to be more open after Sara encourages her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and feeling responsible, and that she had been emotionally reserved; Sara suspected Shirley was holding back her feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara learns that Shirley's reticence comes from fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley is willing to try opening up with encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is suppressing her emotions partly due to concerns about professionalism and strength, but she is receptive to expressing them in a safe, friendly context.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, compassionate, and cautiously hopeful after Shirley agrees to try.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her emotions, normalize emotional openness, and provide a safe space for her to do so.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong; Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology. Shirley also says she wants to keep talking because it helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving, feeling responsible, and trying to be more open, but Sara worried that her previous confrontation had been too harsh and might have strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara learns her apology is accepted and that Shirley values their continued talks; her worry about damaging the friendship is alleviated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is receptive to Sara's support, appreciates the apology, and wants their supportive conversations to continue; Sara should balance honesty with sensitivity.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To mend and strengthen the friendship, remain available for Shirley, respect her boundaries, and continue supportive talks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley seems to be doing better. Shirley confirms she feels better thanks to their talks and Sara's support, and she accepts Sara's suggestion to spend time together outside work and plan something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still processing grief and guilt but had been increasingly receptive to support and valued their talks; Sara hoped Shirley was improving.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Sara's observation of improvement is confirmed by Shirley, and she learns that her support has helped; Shirley also wants to deepen their connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better and values Sara's support; continued social contact outside work may help her further, and their friendship is growing stronger.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley, spend more time with her outside work, and plan a weekend activity together.
